caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure with reddish-brown skin, wearing a feathered headdress and a decorated loincloth. The headdress features multiple vertical feathers in shades of brown, red, and yellow. The figure has a stern facial expression and is adorned with arm bands, a belt with round decorations, and a necklace with a pendant. His right arm is bent at the elbow with the fist slightly clenched and raised, while the left arm is at his side, holding an object near his waist. The figure wears moccasin-like footwear and has additional feathered elements attached to the sides of his thighs and the back of the belt. The statue stands on a gray, tiered rectangular pedestal. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
